speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To understand your condition better, have you noticed any rash, stiff neck, or changes in your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Listeriosis. The patient's history of consuming unpasteurized ice cream (a known source of Listeria monocytogenes) combined with fever, headache, and malaise in a third-trimester pregnant woman is highly suggestive of listeriosis, which can present as sepsis or meningitis.
